source: GeoSphere Austria SPARTACUS v3 daily + INCA v2 hourly fallback
note: SPARTACUS is the primary source and revises recent days. The updater re-fetches a 150-day SPARTACUS source window on every run. Only complete local calendar days after the latest valid SPARTACUS day may be provisionally filled from INCA, with a maximum of 3 days. Existing SPARTACUS values are never overwritten by INCA. Missing INCA hours are never interpreted as zero.
